aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An aimless nightcrawler becomes the target of a sinister supernatural entity and must uncover its origins before he is consumed by the dark.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Drifting through the city's shadows without a clear purpose, an aimless nightcrawler suddenly finds himself marked by an elusive, malevolent creature. As the supernatural entity closes in, he is forced to navigate the underworld to unravel the mystery behind why he is being hunted. With time running out, his desperate search for answers turns into a high-stakes struggle for survival against an otherworldly threat. Ultimately, he must face his own inner demons alongside the literal monster pursuing him.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Trapped in a cycle of aimless wandering through the nocturnal landscape, a lonely nightcrawler stumbles into a reality far darker than he ever anticipated. After a series of inexplicable and terrifying encounters, he realizes he is actively being stalked by a shadowy supernatural entity. The creature operates from the fringes of his perception, driving him into a state of heightened paranoia and desperation. Determined to understand the nature of this ancient threat, he plunges into a murky investigation across the city's hidden corners. Along the way, he seeks out obscure lore, uncovers cryptid rumors, and unravels clues left behind by previous victims who met a grim fate. As the entity's attacks become increasingly violent and aggressive, the nightcrawler's journey forces him to confront the psychological toll of his isolated existence. Every shadow becomes a potential death trap, blurring the line between his unraveling sanity and genuine physical danger. Time grows short as the creature narrows its reach, compelling him to construct a dangerous plan to outsmart the beast. In a tense culmination, he must leverage every instinct he has cultivated in the dark to break the creature's hunt and secure his freedom.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: It Hunts follows an aimless wanderer of the night who becomes the target of a terrifying, supernatural predator. Operating in the twilight spaces of the city, the protagonist must piecemeal together clues, lore, and urban mysteries to figure out why this otherworldly force has marked him. Blending suspenseful horror with dramatic depth, the narrative explores isolation and survival as the hunter becomes the hunted in a deadly race against time.
